open_points.subject: OwnerSession last-request instant
open_points.text: M11 says “changed by the owner's requests: the instant of its last request”, while “Revisions and times” says “Every other model carries only the written-once instants its own facts name”.
open_points.question: Is OwnerSession an exception that carries a mutable instant, or is the last-request instant not a stored OwnerSession fact?
options: OwnerSession explicitly carries a mutable last-request instant
OwnerSession carries only written-once instants and derives or does not retain last-request time
open_points.default_guess: Make OwnerSession an explicit exception and store the mutable last-request instant.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession disclosure classes
open_points.text: M11 adds “the import file uploaded in it”, while the disclosure table classifies “the owner session” and “every other fact of every model” as `business_confidential`; an import file contains Customer and Object values classified as `personal_data`.
open_points.question: What disclosure class applies to the uploaded import file and to an OwnerSession containing it?
options: Classify the uploaded file as `personal_data` and the containing answer accordingly
Treat the file as an opaque business-confidential blob despite its personal-data contents
Keep the file outside OwnerSession and classify only a non-personal reference as its fact
open_points.default_guess: Classify the uploaded file as `personal_data` and never expose it through ordinary OwnerSession projections.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession pending confirmations
open_points.question: What facts constitute a pending confirmation, and can a session hold one pending confirmation in total, one per confirmable action, or several concurrent confirmations?
options: One pending confirmation carrying its action kind and action-specific target values
One pending confirmation per confirmable action kind
open_points.default_guess: Keep one pending confirmation containing the action kind and the values needed to bind the later confirmation.

open_points.subject: Pending-confirmation lifecycle
open_points.text: “each kept until used, replaced or the session ends”
open_points.question: Which product actions create, replace, read and clear pending confirmation values, and does a refused or failed confirmed action count as their being “used”?
options: Preparing any confirmable owner action creates or replaces them; every confirmation attempt clears them
Preparing creates or replaces them; only an accepted confirmed action clears them
Each confirmable action manages its own pending values independently
open_points.default_guess: Preparation creates or replaces them, the corresponding confirmation reads them, and any confirmation attempt consumes them.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession last-request updates
open_points.text: “changed by the owner's requests: the instant of its last request”
open_points.question: Which requests move the last-request instant: every authenticated owner-interface request, only product actions, reads as well as changes, confirmation preparation and submission, import upload, and sign-out?
options: Every authenticated owner-interface request moves it
Only successful product reads and changes move it
Only state-changing product actions move it
open_points.default_guess: Every authenticated owner-interface request except sign-out moves it, whether the product action succeeds or fails.

open_points.subject: Uploaded import file
open_points.text: “the import file uploaded in it, each kept until used, replaced or the session ends”
open_points.question: What product action uploads or replaces the file, which action reads it, and exactly when is it removed—on an import attempt, only after successful import, or also after a refused import?
options: A separate upload action stores or replaces it; any import attempt consumes it
A separate upload action stores or replaces it; only a successful import consumes it
The confirmed import action both uploads and consumes it without a separately retained file
open_points.default_guess: A separate owner upload action stores or replaces it; the confirmed import reads it, and only a successful import consumes it.
